message: Reading these other comments sounds very familiar.  Our son is in a jail in Oregon, and at first we were receiving regular calls from him, and then they suddenly stopped.  We learned through other family members and his letters that every time he tried to call us he got a message that this number was not receiving collect calls.  I called our local phone company and learned that they had no block on our phone, so I called the billing company, and then T-NETIX, and was informed that they had changed their billing system and blocked our phone until we set up an account with them.  Because we need to hear from our son, and he needs to hear us, I went ahead and gave them my SS number, but somebody ought to close that crooked outfit down permanently.
